description: Land Title Settlement Department - Harakgalegama, Katana D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511200
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules with specific land parcel numbers, owner information, property extents, and encumbrances. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes), and appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette publication.
